Lock closure cuts Alpha grain loadings

[P1] The Alpha harbour authority said loadings of grain fell sharply in March after the river lock closed for repairs.

[P2] Exporters moved part of the cargo to the rail line through Gamma, but the rail operator said its spare capacity was limited.
